name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No Atlantic tropical cyclone listed on 20 Nov; the quiet 2026 season ends on 30 Nov
state: GDACS listed two tropical cyclones worldwide at 05:41 UTC on 20 Nov, Xavier near the Cook Islands and Akvan near India, and none in the Atlantic basin (GDACS). AccuWeather judged the Atlantic season's tropical activity over on 9 Nov, after 10 named storms and one hurricane. The season formally ends on 30 Nov, so no storm threatens land and the level stays Normal.
for_you: No Atlantic storm is active. Travellers to the Caribbean and US Gulf coast face no tropical threat at present; the season formally ends on 30 Nov.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active or threatening land within 5 days (Normal)

sources.title: AccuWeather — 2026 Atlantic hurricane season is over

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).
